evidence.claim: Proton documents client-side/end-to-end encryption for Drive file contents and selected metadata.
Proton lists Drive access for Android, iOS/iPadOS, Windows, macOS and web.

software.internetRequirement: Required for cloud synchronization and remote file access; some downloaded files can be used offline
limitations: Collaboration features differ from Google Workspace
software.name: Proton Drive
software.networkActivity: Network is required for cloud synchronization, upload/download, and sharing; previously downloaded offline files can remain locally accessible
software.pricing: Free and paid plans; verify current official pricing

privacyDetails.advertising: Not documented as a core Drive use in the checked product documentation
privacyDetails.analytics: Not documented in the checked Drive product pages
privacyDetails.collected: Account and service metadata are separate from encrypted file content. Proton states that file contents and selected metadata such as filenames/folder names are encrypted on the device before upload.
privacyDetails.controls: Users control files, sharing, local/offline copies, and account storage; service-level privacy controls are documented separately.
privacyDetails.deletion: Cloud deletion and local copies are distinct; shared or exported copies can remain elsewhere.
privacyDetails.encryption: Proton states that Drive encrypts file contents, filenames, and folder names on the device before upload.
privacyDetails.practicalImplications: Client-side encryption reduces Proton's access to file contents and covered metadata, but account identifiers and operational metadata should not be assumed to be hidden.
privacyDetails.purpose: Provide encrypted cloud file storage, synchronization, sharing, and account operation.
privacyDetails.recipients: Proton infrastructure stores encrypted Drive data and necessary account/service metadata; user-chosen share recipients receive shared content according to sharing controls.
privacyDetails.sale: Not documented in the checked Drive product documentation
privacyDetails.sharing: File sharing is user-directed; links and shared access create intentional recipients.
privacyDetails.tracking: Not documented in the checked Drive product pages
